decision: The competitor (Williams F1 Team) is fined €1,000
event_name: Document 26 Date 08 October 2022 Time 14:34 2022 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 06 - 09 October 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 24), summoned (document 25) and heard from the team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Failing to use a complete set of tyres as allocated.
offence: Breach of Article 30.2 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative, the Technical Delegate and the F1 Technical Assistant. The team agreed with the report that 3 tyres from set 202 were used and 1 from set 203 and conceded this was a breach of the regulations. Taking into account the
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Wiliams Car 23 Use Of Tyres
